concepts.title: 星潮花园
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished landscape 16:9 architectural environment concept image, no collage, for an explorable cozy fantasy 3D rooftop observatory above a luminous archipelago sea. This is a proposed visual direction, not a screenshot. Input image 1 is the existing real application: use ONLY its spatial anchors (botanical cocktail bar left, mature star tree middle-left, traversable floor curving to a round galaxy portal middle-right, recognizable small warm wooden return door right, brass telescope on right), NOT its low-detail background. Input image 2 is the user's earlier preferred concept: use its fine wood, brass, lush layered plants, handcrafted curved seating, tactile fabrics, subtle glass, carefully localized warm light as material quality guide. Keep a believable rooftop at human scale with railing, no people, no UI, no labels, no typography. Use consistent eye-level wide camera, looking from the deck entrance toward the bar/tree/portal and archipelago. Foreground and walkable deck about 55 percent, distant sea islands and sky about 45 percent. Clear roughly 1.8 metre circulation route; plants frame but do not barricade the star portal and return door. Furnishing diversity: vertical, overhead, floor-level, attached and suspended objects, not rows of tables. Dense intentional craft detail near interaction areas, calmer navigable floor. Physically credible wood grain, weathered brass, soft cushions, layered botanical silhouettes, glass highlights, strong warm/cool light separation, readable shadows and rich midtones, restrained bloom, no extreme glare, no excessive tiny sparkles, no generic polygon mountains or identical island blocks. Rich fantasy architectural concept art in convincing high-end 3D material realism. Direction A: STAR-TIDE GARDEN. An intimate, abundant botanical night sanctuary in indigo, turquoise and warm amber. Rebuild the bar as a small vine-covered greenhouse alcove with a curved copper bottle rail, luminous botanical infusions and hanging dried herbs, one beautiful work counter only. Around the massive tree: curved sunken bench with soft textiles, fine ferns and flowering groundcover at multiple heights; a shallow moonwater rill around the planter with tiny stepping bridges; overhead delicate glass seed terrariums and suspended celestial chimes; a woven hanging reading pod tucked left. Keep the center path readable. The ornate brass galaxy portal is integrated into flowering branches. Background is dramatically richer than the input: organically eroded pearl-white crescent shorelines, one large natural sea arch, purple-crowned island forests and layered mist separating near/mid/far silhouettes. Show a sweep of turquoise bioluminescence curling around the island coves, accurate warm lantern reflections broken by ripples. Quiet cloud bands crossing the stars, a thin ribbon of windblown petals and a few luminous moths imply slow motion. Focus on inviting personal scale and natural magic; no floating land masses in this direction. A distant warm waterfall and luminous tidal lines make the sea feel alive.
